pages.text: We're quite pleased with your progress and we think it's time you stand on your own for once.$(br2)You have been proven to be a quite resourceful specimen and we have trust that you will manage this task.$(br2)If you happen to fail though you would be stuck here for an indefinite amount of time, so yeah don't fail us.

pages.title: Good luck you dummy
pages.text: To enter the next $(item)Simulation$() you need a lot of $(item)Cobblestone$().$(br2)You may need to construct several $(item)Spectral Relays$() to boost the starlight available to your $(item)Starlight Crafting Altar$() to be able to craft the $(item)Blessed Portal Stone$().

pages.title: Portal Activator
pages.text: Lighting the $(item)Portal$() to the third $(item)Simulation$() requires you to hold a $(item)Lunar Plane Idol$().
